```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(posterior)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Load data}
# Compact helper function to read raw CSVs
read_cleaned <- function(file) {
  read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "cleaned", file),
           stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
           check.names = FALSE)
}

plant_data     <- read_cleaned("plant_data.csv")
mapp_data  <- read_cleaned("mapp_data.csv")
bee_data      <- read_cleaned("bee_data.csv")
```

# Descriptive analysis plant data
```{r plant data Wilcoxon tests Abundance and Richness}
## Richness
# Wilcoxon test Richness overall site comparison (all visits combined)
sig_label_richness_all <- case_when(
  is.na(tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
                 error = function(e) NA_real_)) ~ "NA",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.001 ~ "***",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.01 ~ "**",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.05 ~ "*",
  tryCatch(wilcox.test(richness ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,
           error = function(e) NA_real_) < 0.1 ~ "°",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

#  Wilcoxon tests for richness per visit
wilcox_results_richness_vis <- plant_data |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(richness ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ "°",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

# Wilcoxon tests for richness by region and visit
wilcox_results_richness_regvis <- plant_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(richness ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ "°",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))


## Relative Abundance
# Wilcoxon test for overall site comparison (all visits combined)
sig_label_abundance_all <- case_when(

  tryCatch(wilcox.test(relabundance ~ site, data = plant_data)$p.value,

)
```

```{r plant data descriptive plots Abundance and Richness}
### Richness plots

# Common y-axis limits
common_ymax_richness <- max(plant_data$richness, na.rm = TRUE)

# Richness by site type 
ggplot(plant_data, aes(x = site, y = richness, fill = site)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Plant Genus Richness per Plot by Site Type",
       x = "Site Type", y = "Number of Genera (Richness)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = common_ymax_richness - 1,
           label = paste("Wilcoxon:", sig_label_richness_all),
           size = 5)

# Richenss by visit and site type
ggplot(plant_data, aes(x = factor(visit), y = richness, fill = site)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "Plant Genus Richness per Plot by Visit and Site Type",
       x = "Visit", y = "Number of Genera (Richness)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(data = wilcox_results_richness_vis,
            aes(x = factor(visit),
                y = common_ymax_richness - 1,
                label = sig_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5)


# Richness by region, visit, and site type
```

# Descriptive analysis habitat mapping
```{r mapp_data patchiness plot}

safe_wilcox <- function(df) {
  # Expect columns: patchiness, site
  site_levels <- unique(df$site)
  if (length(site_levels) != 2) return(NA_real_)
  # At least one non-NA per group
  gcounts <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(patchiness)) |>
    count(site) |> pull(n)
  if (length(gcounts) != 2 || any(gcounts == 0)) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch(
    stats::wilcox.test(patchiness ~ site, data = df)$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}

# Compute p-values & labels
wilcox_results_patchiness <- mapp_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = safe_wilcox(cur_data()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ "°",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

# Common ymax
common_ymax_patch <- max(mapp_data$patchiness, na.rm = TRUE)
ylab_patch <- "Patchiness"

# Region-specific plotting function
plot_region_patch <- function(reg) {
  ggplot(subset(mapp_data, region == reg),
         aes(x = factor(visit), y = patchiness, fill = site)) +
    geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge()) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min(mapp_data$patchiness, na.rm = TRUE),
                             common_ymax_patch)) +
    labs(title = reg, x = "Visit", y = ylab_patch) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("focal" = "#1b9e77", "control" = "#d95f02")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    geom_text(
      data = subset(wilcox_results_patchiness, region == reg),
      aes(x = factor(visit),
          y = common_ymax_patch - 0.05 *
            (common_ymax_patch - min(mapp_data$patchiness, na.rm = TRUE)),
          label = sig_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5
    )
}

regions_to_plot <- c("Aire", "Scheulte", "Thiele", "Schwarzbach")
plots <- map(regions_to_plot, plot_region_patch)

patchiness_patchwork <- (plots[[1]] | plots[[2]]) / (plots[[3]] | plots[[4]])
patchiness_patchwork

```


# Descriptive analysis bee data
```{r bee data overview numbers}
# total species count
length(which(names(bee_data) == "Andrena aeneiventris"):
         which(names(bee_data) == "Stelis punctulatissima"))



# Derive species column block by names (robust to column reordering)
start <- match("Andrena aeneiventris", names(bee_data))
end   <- match("Stelis punctulatissima", names(bee_data))
species_cols <- start:end

# Logical presence (>=1) per site type
control_pres <- colSums(bee_data[bee_data$site == "control",
                                 species_cols] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
focal_pres   <- colSums(bee_data[bee_data$site == "focal",
                                 species_cols] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0

# Number of Bee species by site
sum(control_pres)
sum(focal_pres)

```
```{r species accumulation curve}

p_accumsite <- function() {

  colnames(bee_data)

  bee_matrix <- bee_data[, !(names(bee_data) %in% c(
    "surveyID","plotID","site","region","visit","plot",
    "richness","fieldIDsum","bee_abundance_nofieldID","bee_abundance",
    "RLabund_LC","RLabund_NT","RLabund_VU","RLabund_EN","RLabund_DD",
    "RLrich_LC","RLrich_NT","RLrich_VU","RLrich_EN","RLrich_DD",
    "RLrich_CR","RLabund_CR","RLrich_threatened","RLabund_threatened",
    "RLrich_total","RLabund_total"))]

  spec_accum <- specaccum(bee_matrix, method = "random")

  site_cols <- list(
    focal   = "#2C7FB8",
    control = "#D95F09"
  )
  site_cols$focal_light   <- adjustcolor(site_cols$focal,   alpha.f = 0.25)
  site_cols$control_light <- adjustcolor(site_cols$control, alpha.f = 0.25)

  plot(spec_accum,
       xlab = "Number of surveys (plot visits)",
       ylab = "Accumulated species richness",
       main = "Species Accumulation Curve",
       ci.type = "polygon",
       col = "#C71586",
       lwd = 2,
       ci.col = adjustcolor("#C71586", alpha.f = 0.25),
       ci.lty = 0)

  bee_matrix_control <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "control", ]
  bee_matrix_focal   <- bee_matrix[bee_data$site == "focal",   ]

  bee_accum_control <- specaccum(bee_matrix_control, method = "random")
  bee_accum_focal   <- specaccum(bee_matrix_focal,   method = "random")

  ylim_all <- range(
    c(bee_accum_control$richness - bee_accum_control$sd,
      bee_accum_control$richness + bee_accum_control$sd,
      bee_accum_focal$richness   - bee_accum_focal$sd,
      bee_accum_focal$richness   + bee_accum_focal$sd),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  plot(bee_accum_control,
       xlab = "Number of surveys (plot visits)",
       ylab = "Accumulated species richness",
       main = "Species Accumulation: Control vs Focal Sites",
       ci.type = "polygon",
       col    = site_cols$control,
       lwd    = 2,
       ci.col = site_cols$control_light,
       ci.lty = 0,
       ylim   = ylim_all)

  plot(bee_accum_focal,
       add    = TRUE,
       col    = site_cols$focal,
       lwd    = 2,
       ci.type = "polygon",
       ci.col = site_cols$focal_light,
       ci.lty = 0)

  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c("Control", "Focal"),
         col    = c(site_cols$control, site_cols$focal),
         lwd    = 2,
         bty    = "n")
}
p_accumsite()
```

```{r bee data wilcoxon tests}

# Bee species richness - run Wilcoxon test across all visits and regions
wilcox_beeri_all <- wilcox.test(bee_richness ~ site, data = bee_data)

sig_label_beeri_all <- case_when(
  wilcox_beeri_all$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  wilcox_beeri_all$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
  wilcox_beeri_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# Bee species richness - run Wilcoxon test per visit across all regions
wilcox_beeri_by_visit <- bee_data |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(bee_richness ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_),
    sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0(sig_label, "\n(p = ", round(p_value, 3), ")"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Bee species richness - run Wilcoxon tests for each region and visit
wilcox_results_beeri <- bee_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    n_focal = sum(site == "focal"),
    n_control = sum(site == "control"),
    p_value = if (n_focal >= 1 & n_control >= 1) {
      tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(bee_richness ~ site)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wilcox_results_beeri <- wilcox_results_beeri |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

# Bee abundance - run Wilcoxon test across all visits and regions
wilcox_beeab_all <- wilcox.test(bee_abundance ~ site, data = bee_data)

sig_label_beeab_all <- case_when(
  wilcox_beeab_all$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  wilcox_beeab_all$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
  wilcox_beeab_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# Bee abundance - run Wilcoxon test per visit across all regions
wilcox_beeab_by_visit <- bee_data |>
  group_by(visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(bee_abundance ~ site)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_),
    sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0(sig_label, "\n(p = ", round(p_value, 3), ")"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Bee abudnance - run Wilcoxon tests for each region and visit
wilcox_results_beeab <- bee_data |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    n_focal = sum(site == "focal"),
    n_control = sum(site == "control"),
    p_value = if (n_focal >= 1 & n_control >= 1) {
      tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(bee_abundance ~ site)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wilcox_results_beeab <- wilcox_results_beeab |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))
```

```{r export for BAFU report}
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    labs(title = "Bienenabundanz pro Standort",
         x = "",
         y = "Abundanz pro Probefläche") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("focal" = "Renaturiert", "control" = "Kontrollabschnitt")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("focal" = "#66c2a5", "control" = "#8c8c8c")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(t = 5)),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(r = 5)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 21, margin = margin(r = 15)),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 21),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, l = 5, b = 5),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 21, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 4),
          legend.position = "none",
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
          panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(bee_data$bee_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) + 10)) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = max(bee_data$bee_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) + 5,
             label = paste(sig_label_beeab_all),
             size = 6, vjust = 1, hjust = 0.5)
)

ggsave("../output/figures/bee_richness_de.jpg",
       width  = 5333, height = 4105, units = "px", dpi = 800,
       plot = ggplot(bee_data, aes(x = site, y = bee_richness, fill = site)) +

               axis.title.y = element_text(size = 21, margin = margin(r = 15)),
```

```{r bee Red List Wilcoxon & plots}
# Wilcoxon test across all visits & sites (paired)
wilcox_rlrich_all <- wilcox.test(
  bee_data$RLrich_threatened,
  bee_data$RLrich_total - bee_data$RLrich_threatened,
  paired = TRUE
)

sig_label_rlrich_all <- case_when(
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
  wilcox_rlrich_all$p.value < 0.1 ~ ".",
  TRUE ~ "ns"
)

# Prepare long format for plotting
rl_plotdata_rich <- bee_data |>
  mutate(RLrich_non_threatened = RLrich_total - RLrich_threatened) |>
  select(surveyID, site, region, visit, RLrich_threatened, RLrich_non_threatened) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("RLrich_"),
               names_to = "RL_category",
               values_to = "value")

# Plot RL richness
ggplot(rl_plotdata_rich, aes(x = factor(visit), y = value, fill = RL_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  labs(
    title = "Red List Bee Richness (Threatened vs Non-threatened)",
    x = "Visit",
    y = "Number of Species",
    fill = "Category"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "RLrich_threatened" = "#d95f02",
    "RLrich_non_threatened" = "#1b9e77"
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1.5, y = max(rl_plotdata_rich$value, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
           label = paste("Wilcoxon:", sig_label_rlrich_all),
           size = 5)

# RL Richness per region & visit
wilcox_results_rlrich <- bee_data |>
  mutate(RLrich_non_threatened = RLrich_total - RLrich_threatened) |>
  group_by(region, visit) |>
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(RLrich_threatened, RLrich_non_threatened, paired = TRUE)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    is.na(p_value) ~ "NA",
    p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_value < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_value < 0.05 ~ "*",
    p_value < 0.1 ~ ".",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

rl_plotdata_rich <- bee_data |>
  mutate(RLrich_non_threatened = RLrich_total - RLrich_threatened) |>
  select(surveyID, site, region, visit, RLrich_threatened, RLrich_non_threatened) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("RLrich_"),
               names_to = "RL_category",
               values_to = "value")

common_ymax_rlrich <- max(rl_plotdata_rich$value, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_rl_rich <- ggplot(rl_plotdata_rich, aes(x = factor(visit), y = value, fill = RL_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~region) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, common_ymax_rlrich)) +
  labs(title = "RL Richness (Threatened vs Non-threatened)",
       x = "Visit", y = "Number of Species", fill = "Category") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("RLrich_threatened" = "#d95f02",
                               "RLrich_non_threatened" = "#1b9e77")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_text(data = wilcox_results_rlrich,
            aes(x = factor(visit), y = common_ymax_rlrich - 1, label = sig_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5)
```
